input.body:
Hi Harriet,

Re: Flat 21, 129 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ9 4ZZ – ref R/PM044-1

Thank you for confirming it is the window at the top of the staircase. Your landlord has agreed for us to send a contractor to fit a new handle. We are now arranging a contractor and they or we will be in touch to agree a time to attend.

In the meantime, please don't force the window or the latch. If anything changes (for example the window won't stay shut), let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
